## History

Katie Maurice is an imaginary friend created by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her lonely childhood before moving to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) used to talk to her reflection in the glass of a bookcase, pretending that the girl in the mirror was named Katie Maurice and treating her as a dear, secret companion. Although [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eventually had to leave Katie behind when she was taken away, she fondly remembers her former imaginary confidante.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--katie-maurice.md)

Katie Maurice is [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's imaginary playmate and designated bosom friend. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invented her to serve as a companion and confidante before coming to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
